ComponentDescription: Listens on the LOCAL MQTT broker for SD-WAN path-control commands (fiber / 5g / auto) and applies them to the gateway's local path-selection API at http://127.0.0.1:8090/api/path. Plain mqtt to the same local broker the clientdevices.mqtt.Bridge relays (cloud<->gateway handled by the bridge, like rdk/ipsec/metrics). Deps pinned for the gateway's Node 10 runtime (mqtt@4, axios@0.27). No certs, no IPC. Long-running.
